theorems.name: component monotonicity; merger is irreversible
theorems.statement: incidence_components unions ('q',orbit)<->('h',hexagon) for every set orbit_masks phase bit and nothing else; orbit_masks bits are only ever set, never cleared; a union-find whose edge set only grows can only coarsen. Hence same-component is permanent and mergers are irreversible.

theorems.name: component-separation arguments are structurally dead in merged families
theorems.statement: In a family already merged before R2, condition 6 (same_component) is satisfied at every descendant for every orbit pair in the merged component. No T4-style argument -- which works exclusively by proving same_component unreachable -- can close such a family. This PROVES rather than assumes the premise that ordinary T4 is inapplicable.
theorems.relation_to_generic_template: MERGED_BY_R is exactly the class where hypothesis D3 (Phi(q_R1) intersect H_hub = empty) of RR_SHORT_T4_GENERIC_THEORY_CLAUDE.md sec5a fails at R1; the template's own sec6 counterexample for dropping D3 predicted this family

theorems.name: residual obstruction set for merged families
theorems.statement: In a merged family the only Target-A obstructions that can bind are conditions 1-5: exactly_two_R_events, immediately_after_R2, F==1, H==0, hub_touch_count<=2. Exhaustive because the recognizer accepts iff all six named conditions hold and condition 6 is discharged by M2.

theorems.name: the Target-A predicate is hex_masks-blind
theorems.statement: target_a_recognizer reads only r_count(before/after), joint_kind, transition.state.F, transition.state.H, after.hub_touch_count, joint_source_state.p, transition.target, and incidence_components(joint_source_state) which reads only state.orbit_masks. It never reads hex_masks.

theorems.name: sound one-sided simulation for impossibility
theorems.statement: Let Omega(state,dec)=(orbit_masks,p,F,H,r_count,hub_touch_count). Legality is conjunctive, so dropping the hex_masks no-repeat guard only ADDS transitions; every legal exact descent maps to a legal Omega-descent. Hence exact-reachable Target-A boundaries are a SUBSET of Omega-reachable ones. If an Omega-search finds no Target-A boundary, no exact descendant has one.
theorems.direction_warning: converse FAILS and must never be used: an Omega-reachable Target-A boundary is not evidence of an exact one
theorems.practical_value: Omega discards the 720-bit occupancy vector -- the dominant part of exact state and the reason F7/F8 families cap out; a negative Omega result is a proof, upgrading (B) to (D) without a larger exact search
theorems.caveat: Omega still carries orbit_masks (144x5 bits); tractability NOT verified and NOT claimed

theorems.name: hub-touch hereditary death
theorems.statement: advance_decoration only ever does touch_count+=1 with no decrement path anywhere; evaluate_edge refuses to produce a child when it would exceed 2; Target-A condition 5 requires <=2. Hence hub_touch_count>2 is hereditarily Target-A-dead and the engine will not generate the subtree.
theorems.committed_lemma: the project's own prune registry records 'with F <= 1, no hexagon can be a joint target more than twice', scope universally_safe_under_F_le_1, test test_hub_touch_counter_is_monotone

theorems.name: SEPARATE_CLEAR transition dichotomy
theorems.status: CLAUDE_HAND_PROOF for the enumerated cases; CONJECTURE for exhaustiveness
theorems.statement: Every legal macro edge out of an SC state is exactly one of: R at r_count==1 (terminal R2, never enqueued); R at r_count>=2 (DEAD); Z2 (may connect -> MZ); Z3 (connects only if the fresh orbit's registered phase-hexagon already lies in the other component -- a component-changing Z3); or a budget-exceeding edge (DEAD).
theorems.provable_asymmetry: SC can NEVER transition to MR, because MR is defined by R1 having created the merger and R1 is already in the past for every post-R1 state

unification.answer: YES -- MR and MZ are the same concept: already-connected-before-R2
unification.proof: M1 makes connection irreversible and M2 makes it permanently satisfied; the recognizer recomputes incidence_components fresh from orbit_masks (docstring: 'Fresh union-find from ExactState; no history summary is trusted'), so the PROVENANCE of the merger has no effect whatsoever on the Target-A predicate

post_merger_normal_form.statement: Once the R2 source and target orbits are co-component before R2, the only remaining freedom relevant to Target A is the literal R2 source orbit/phase plus the resource coordinates (F,H,r_count,hub_touch_count).
post_merger_normal_form.proved_half: 'only remaining freedom' -- proved by M3 + M4
post_merger_normal_form.unproved_half: that the admissible source set is finite AND branch-independent -- NOT proved and NOT asserted; branch-independence looks doubtful since sq ranges over whatever orbits a branch has actually opened

unification.separate_document_rationale: the result is one theorem plus one open half, it lives naturally in the main report, and this project has just endorsed consolidation over file proliferation; split it out only once the finite-image half is proved
